entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-08-05
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • SignalR Java Client 9.0.4: Memory leak in stream() method due to unbounded ReplaySubject #63134
  • Expose the UnhandledException event #63133
  • UseSolutionRelativeContentRoot overloads to support slnx discovery #63131
  • ASPNETCORE_HOSTINGSTARTUPASSEMBLIES not working for Blazor wasm development server #63130
  • PersistentState attribute inconsistent behavior on page navigation #63129
    10.0-rc1
  • Error testing from CLI #63128
  • Expose BearerTokenHandler from Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication #63127
  • Use internal constructors in JSON deserialization with Blazor JS Interop #63124
  • Perf regression: caching, fortunes, fortunes_dapper #63123
  • Perf regression: json, json, kestrel-encoded-url #63122
  • Perf improvement: fortunes, updates #63121
  • CORS - AnyOrigin & WithOrigins has no effect #63120

Closed

  • Blazor sets EditForm Model to null in unexpected situations #51420
    10.0-rc1
  • PersistentState attribute throws InvalidOperationException at runtime when used with private property #62859
    10.0-rc1
  • Allow access modifiers for Razor component classes (e.g., internal for Blazor components) #63041
  • Virtualize component spacers are not accessible #62989
    10.0-rc1
  • Unable to run my project with Visual Studio 17.14.11 #63112
  • Incorrect nullability on IApiRequestFormatMetadataProvider.GetSupportedContentTypes #62405
    Backlog
  • [.NET 10] ValidationsGenerator throws some errors due to inaccessibility #62757
    10.0-rc1

    area-blazor, 10.0-rc1

    area-blazor, 10.0-rc1

    area-mvc, community-contribution, 10.0-rc1
  • [release/8.0] Update SignalR Redis tests to use internal Docker Hub mirror #63117
